text:
marta: Kicking off a controlled blue->green ramp for north-eu router group during the 01:15-01:45 UTC change window. Plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, 3m observe between steps. Deploy-bot will post each step.

deploy-bot: starting rollout: router-service v1.9.2 -> v1.10.0 on north-eu. initial canary applied: green=10%. command: `routerctl shift --group north-eu --to green --weight 10`

sam: ack. I've pinned session-store to v1.9.2 for north-eu to avoid schema drift. Lock set: `session-pin:1.9.2`

chen: watching p95, 5xx rate, and backend latencies. Rollback criteria: p95 > 250ms OR 5xx > 2% sustained for >=3m. Also watch 502 count at the gateway.

olga: throwing in gateway 502 and token-imbalance too. If we see tail latency or auth errors, we hold.

monitoring-bot: canary metrics (north-eu) — p95: 135ms, errors(5xx): 0.4%, gateway_502: 0/min, QPS change: +9%

marta: good. ramp to 30% in ~3m if metrics look stable. I'll call ramp at T+4.

deploy-bot: ramping to 30%: `routerctl shift --group north-eu --to green --weight 30`

monitoring-bot: update (T+2m) — p95: 410ms, errors(5xx): 1.1%, gateway_502: 3 in last 2m

sam: whoa p95 jumped. pausing ramp. 

marta: pausing and reverting to previous distribution (green->10). Hold change window for now.

chen: recommend immediate rollback to mitigate. Triggering rollback to blue-majority and drain new instances. Rollback command: ```
routerctl shift --group north-eu --to green --weight 10
routerctl drain --group north-eu --selector version=v1.10.0 --grace 30s
```

deploy-bot: rollback executed: green=10%, blue=90%. Drain initiated for v1.10.0 pool.

monitoring-bot: post-rollback metrics — p95: 140ms, errors(5xx): 0.3%, gateway_502: 0/min

olga: looks stable after rollback. Good catch.

marta: thanks team. We'll stop this rollout for now. Action items: 1) run load test against v1.10.0 in staging to reproduce tail latency, 2) add additional canary with shadow traffic for 48h next change window, 3) document version pinning we applied.

sam: i've logged the session-store pin and added a note to the release: "pinned session-store 1.9.2 while router v1.10.0 investigated"

chen: creating incident/bug to capture tail-latency traces and opentelemetry spans for the canary period.

marta: scheduling a short postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. We'll re-run with smaller step increments and a 5m observation window. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout status: aborted (manual rollback by marta). All traffic returned to blue-majority. Please avoid re-scheduling automatic ramps until postmortem complete.

sam: ack. I'll update release notes with the aborted rollout and rollback rationale.

olga: leaving note to ops on-call: if you see >200ms p95 next time, hold and notify immediately.

marta: thanks — closing thread for now. We'll reopen when we have repro steps. :white_check_mark:
